name: QA Quality Gate: ingest JUnit results

parameters.content:
## CI Quality Gate & Flaky Test Detector

`POST /webhook/qa/results` with header `X-QA-Token` and a JSON body:

```json
{ "project": "org/repo", "branch": "main", "commit": "abc123",
  "build_url": "https://...", "min_pass_rate": 95,
  "junit_xml": "<testsuites>...</testsuites>" }
```

1. Validates the request (400 with every problem listed).
2. Parses the JUnit XML, as written by pytest, Maven Surefire and other test runners (400 if it isn't well-formed XML, 422 if it has no test cases).
3. Stores the run in the `qa_metrics` Postgres database.
4. Compares it with the previous run on the same branch and looks for flaky tests in the last 10 runs.
5. Returns the verdict: `gate` is `passed` or `failed`, with reasons and a Markdown summary for CI.

**Gate policy:** fail on a new failure that isn't a known flaky test, or when the pass rate is below `min_pass_rate`. Known flaky tests are reported but never block.

parameters.query:
-- Stores the run and all of its test results in one statement.
WITH run AS (
  INSERT INTO test_runs (project, branch, commit_sha, build_url, total, passed, failed, skipped, duration_ms)
  VALUES ($1, $2, NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF($4, ''), $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
  RETURNING id
), saved AS (
  INSERT INTO test_results (run_id, test_id, suite, name, status, duration_ms, message, retried)
  SELECT run.id, t.test_id, t.suite, t.name, t.status, t.duration_ms, t.message, t.retried
  FROM run, jsonb_to_recordset($10::jsonb) AS t (
    test_id text, suite text, name text, status text, duration_ms integer, message text, retried boolean
  )
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT run.id AS run_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM saved)::int AS saved_results FROM run;

-- Compares this run with the previous run of the same project and branch, and finds flaky tests:
-- tests whose result flipped between pass and fail at least $3 times in the last $2 runs,
-- or that only passed after a rerun.
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT id, project, branch FROM test_runs WHERE id = $1::bigint
), recent AS (
  SELECT r.id FROM test_runs r JOIN cur ON r.project = cur.project AND r.branch = cur.branch
  WHERE r.id <= cur.id ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT $2::int
), prev AS (
  SELECT max(r.id) AS id FROM test_runs r JOIN cur ON r.project = cur.project AND r.branch = cur.branch
  WHERE r.id < cur.id
), now_res AS (
  SELECT test_id, status FROM test_results WHERE run_id = $1::bigint
), prev_res AS (
  SELECT test_id, status FROM test_results WHERE run_id = (SELECT id FROM prev)
), history AS (
  SELECT test_id, status, retried,
         lag(status) OVER (PARTITION BY test_id ORDER BY run_id) AS prev_status
  FROM test_results
  WHERE run_id IN (SELECT id FROM recent) AND status <> 'skipped'
), flaky AS (
  SELECT test_id,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE prev_status IS NOT NULL AND (prev_status = 'passed') <> (status = 'passed'))::int AS flips,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE retried)::int AS passed_on_retry,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'passed')::int AS failures,
         count(*)::int AS runs
  FROM history
  GROUP BY test_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT id FROM prev) AS previous_run_id,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM recent)::int AS runs_in_window,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(n.test_id ORDER BY n.test_id)
            FROM now_res n LEFT JOIN prev_res p USING (test_id)
            WHERE n.status IN ('failed', 'error') AND (p.status IS NULL OR p.status NOT IN ('failed', 'error'))),
           '[]'::json) AS new_failures,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(n.test_id ORDER BY n.test_id)
            FROM now_res n JOIN prev_res p USING (test_id)
            WHERE n.status IN ('failed', 'error') AND p.status IN ('failed', 'error')),
           '[]'::json) AS still_failing,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(n.test_id ORDER BY n.test_id)
            FROM now_res n JOIN prev_res p USING (test_id)
            WHERE n.status = 'passed' AND p.status IN ('failed', 'error')),
           '[]'::json) AS fixed,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('test_id', f.test_id, 'flips', f.flips, 'failures', f.failures,
                                              'runs', f.runs, 'passed_on_retry', f.passed_on_retry)
                            ORDER BY f.flips DESC, f.test_id)
            FROM flaky f JOIN now_res n USING (test_id)
            WHERE f.flips >= $3::int OR f.passed_on_retry > 0),
           '[]'::json) AS flaky;
